strings.name: Jung Kook
strings.summary: Jung Kook trained as a teenager and helped carry Korean pop worldwide as a BTS member. Alongside solo tracks within group releases, Seven and his debut solo album Golden developed his English-language pop work. He also performed Dreamers at the World Cup opening ceremony, linking group collaboration, recording and major stages.
